//! Control probe: an injected reader, which the policy permits.
//!
//! This must lint clean. If it does not, the harness is reporting diagnostics
//! that have nothing to do with the environment policy and the other probes'
//! results cannot be trusted.

pub fn reads(read_env: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<String>) -> Option<String> {
    read_env("WILDSIDE_PROBE")
}
